title: Tuning the properties of ASnTe3 (A = Li, Na, K, Rb, Cs) chalcogenide perovskites for optimal solar energy conversion: computational insights
content:
RSC Adv., 2025, 15,25633-25662
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA03088A, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial 3.0 Unported Licence.
Eman Khalafalla Mahmoud, Ali El-Rayyes, Mohamed Taha
DFT study reveals ASnTe3 perovskites as tunable, lead-free candidates for photovoltaics (Na/Rb/CsSnTe3) and thermoelectrics (Li/KSnTe3), with optimal band gaps (0.27–1.32 eV), low thermal conductivity, and ductile mechanical properties.
